title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.7.3
description:
• Dedicated Page Checker & Cookie Inspector Tab: 1-click bulk cookie inspector to verify session validity and detect created Facebook Pages.
• Multi-Threaded Verification Engine: High-speed background verification (8 concurrent workers) with zero browser GUI requirement.
• Live Telemetry & KPI Cards: Real-time tracking of Pages Created, No Pages Yet, and Expired/Checkpoint accounts.
• Smart Export Pipelines: 1-click export of 'With Pages' (managed accounts), 'Without Pages' (clean accounts ready for creation), and Full CSV report.
• Database & File Import: Seamlessly import cookies directly from TXT/CSV or local Records SQLite database.
